Agendas and minutes

All Council meeting agendas, including reports and related attachments, and minutes are available to the community.

Agendas are usually available on the website by 1pm on the Friday prior to the meeting date. The minutes of the meeting will be available on the website after each meeting.

Summaries of the main outcomes of each meeting are also available here.

Ordinary Meeting of 28 October 2026 - Livestream

The Ordinary Meeting will be webcast live from 2pm. The public will be able to view the meeting via livestream through an audio-visual weblink of the meeting. The weblink will be available on the morning of the meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.

A shuttle service will depart on the day from out the front of the MidCoast Council Library in Victoria Street, Taree at:

  • 9am for those registered for the shuttle for the Open and Public forums.
  • 1.30pm for people registered for the shuttle attending the Council Meeting.

The shuttle service will return to Victoria Street at the conclusion of both sessions. No additional pickups or drop offs available. Should you require the shuttle service you must register for that service.

Registration is required to book the shuttle service. Please call our Customer Service Centre on 02 7955 7777 to register. Registrations close 12 noon Tuesday 27 October.

Agendas and minutes

All Council meeting agendas, including reports and related attachments, and minutes are available to the community.

Agendas are usually available on the website by 1pm on the Friday prior to the meeting date. The minutes of the meeting will be available on the website after each meeting.

Summaries of the main outcomes of each meeting are also available here.

Ordinary Meeting of 28 October 2026 - Livestream

The Ordinary Meeting will be webcast live from 2pm. The public will be able to view the meeting via livestream through an audio-visual weblink of the meeting. The weblink will be available on the morning of the meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.

A shuttle service will depart on the day from out the front of the MidCoast Council Library in Victoria Street, Taree at:

  • 9am for those registered for the shuttle for the Open and Public forums.
  • 1.30pm for people registered for the shuttle attending the Council Meeting.

The shuttle service will return to Victoria Street at the conclusion of both sessions. No additional pickups or drop offs available. Should you require the shuttle service you must register for that service.

Registration is required to book the shuttle service. Please call our Customer Service Centre on 02 7955 7777 to register. Registrations close 12 noon Tuesday 27 October.

Agendas and minutes

All Council meeting agendas, including reports and related attachments, and minutes are available to the community.

Agendas are usually available on the website by 1pm on the Friday prior to the meeting date. The minutes of the meeting will be available on the website after each meeting.

Summaries of the main outcomes of each meeting are also available here.

Ordinary Meeting of 28 October 2026 - Livestream

The Ordinary Meeting will be webcast live from 2pm. The public will be able to view the meeting via livestream through an audio-visual weblink of the meeting. The weblink will be available on the morning of the meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.

A shuttle service will depart on the day from out the front of the MidCoast Council Library in Victoria Street, Taree at:

  • 9am for those registered for the shuttle for the Open and Public forums.
  • 1.30pm for people registered for the shuttle attending the Council Meeting.

The shuttle service will return to Victoria Street at the conclusion of both sessions. No additional pickups or drop offs available. Should you require the shuttle service you must register for that service.

Registration is required to book the shuttle service. Please call our Customer Service Centre on 02 7955 7777 to register. Registrations close 12 noon Tuesday 27 October.
